domain.description: The domain that was checked, lowercase, without www or path.

resolves.description: true if the domain exists in DNS, false if it does not (NXDOMAIN), null if the lookup failed.

a.description: IPv4 addresses (A records). Empty unless "Include A/AAAA/CAA records" is on.

aaaa.description: IPv6 addresses (AAAA records). Empty unless "Include A/AAAA/CAA records" is on.

mx.description: MX records as {priority, host}, lowest priority number first. An empty list means no MX (or a null MX).

emailProvider.description: Mail provider guessed from the MX hosts (for example Google Workspace, Microsoft 365), "Other / self-hosted" for unknown hosts, or null when there is no MX.

spf.description: The SPF record text (v=spf1 ...), or null if none is published.

spfAll.description: The SPF "all" qualifier: -all, ~all, ?all or +all. Null when there is no SPF record or no all mechanism.

spfLookups.description: Approximate count of DNS-lookup mechanisms at the top level of the SPF record (include, a, mx, ptr, exists, redirect). SPF allows 10.

dmarc.description: The DMARC record text (v=DMARC1; ...), or null if none is published at _dmarc.<domain>.

dmarcPolicy.description: The DMARC p= policy: none, quarantine or reject. Null when there is no DMARC record or no valid p=.

dmarcRua.description: The DMARC rua= aggregate report address, or null if not set.

dkimSelectorsFound.description: The tested DKIM selectors that returned a key. Only the selectors you test are reported; empty if a wildcard DKIM record answers every selector.

mtaSts.description: true if an MTA-STS record (_mta-sts.<domain>) is published.

bimi.description: true if a BIMI record (default._bimi.<domain>) is published.

caa.description: CAA records. Empty unless "Include A/AAAA/CAA records" is on.

parkedOrForSale.description: Parking or marketplace service detected from the nameservers (for example Afternic, Sedo, Dan.com), or null.

emailScore.description: Email-authentication score 0-100 built from SPF, DMARC, DKIM, MTA-STS and BIMI. See "How to read the score" in the README. It reports DNS records; it does not predict inbox placement.

issues.description: Plain-English problems found, for example "No DMARC record" or "No SPF record". Empty list when nothing was found.

error.description: Error detail when the lookup failed, otherwise null.
